connector.name: Fintable MCP
connector.registryDescription: Unofficial MCP server for fintable.io - manage financial categories, rules, and transactions.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package fintable-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jasoncbraatz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: FINTABLE_COOKIES
env.description: Full cookie header string from Chrome DevTools for fintable.io authentication. Not needed if using rookiepy auto-extraction.

env.name: FINTABLE_SESSION_COOKIE
env.description: Just the fintable_session cookie value (alternative to FINTABLE_COOKIES).
